Name: Spirit Whirled
Overview: Guide Spirit through each progressively challenging level towards the doorway of light, all the while picking up spiraled spirit energy to unlock the door. What will Spirit find along the way and at the end of his ghost adventure!? Give it a play to find out! Thanks for your support! "Spirit Whirled" is a charming game created by husband and wife team, Danilo and E'lan Buendia of cgIRIS.
